hook.en: Chemical fertilisers and pesticides raised yields, but they also harmed soil, water and health. Can farmers grow enough food while protecting the land for their grandchildren?
hook.kn: ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ಕೀಟನಾಶಕಗಳು ಇಳುವರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿದವು, ಆದರೆ ಮಣ್ಣು, ನೀರು ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಿದವು. ಮೊಮ್ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತಲೇ ರೈತರು ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಆಹಾರ ಬೆಳೆಯಬಹುದೇ?

objectives.en: Weigh the benefits and limitations of organic farming

narration.en: Chemical fertilisers and pesticides raised yields, but they also harmed soil, water and health. Can farmers grow enough food while protecting the land for their grandchildren?
narration.kn: ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ಕೀಟನಾಶಕಗಳು ಇಳುವರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿದವು, ಆದರೆ ಮಣ್ಣು, ನೀರು ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಿದವು. ಮೊಮ್ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತಲೇ ರೈತರು ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಆಹಾರ ಬೆಳೆಯಬಹುದೇ?

body.en: Sustainable development meets the needs of the present generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. Organic farming is a whole system of farming that restores, maintains and enhances the ecological balance. It uses organic inputs such as compost, farmyard manure, bio-fertilisers and biological pest control instead of synthetic fertilisers and pesticides.
body.kn: ಸುಸ್ಥಿರ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡದೆ ಇಂದಿನ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕಗಳ ಬದಲು ಕಾಂಪೋಸ್ಟ್, ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಕೀಟ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಬಳಸಿ ಪರಿಸರ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಕಾಪಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Sustainable development meets today's needs without harming future generations. Organic farming restores the ecological balance by using compost, manure and natural pest control instead of chemicals.

narration.en: The teacher draws a two-column comparison of chemical and organic farming, then lists the benefits and limitations.

say.en: Two columns: chemical farming on the left, organic on the right.
Inputs: chemical fertiliser versus compost and manure. Pests: chemical sprays versus neem and natural predators.
Soil health falls with heavy chemical use and improves with organic matter. Costs: bought inputs versus cheaper local inputs.
But yields from organic farms are often lower in the first years.
Benefits: cheaper inputs, export demand, healthier food and more jobs. Limits: lower early yields, shorter shelf life, hard for small farmers to switch.

prompt.en: Sort each practice: is it part of organic farming, or of chemical-based farming?
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ: ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿಯದ್ದೇ ಅಥವಾ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಕೃಷಿಯದ್ದೇ?

text.en: Crop rotation to restore the soil
Green manure crops ploughed into the field

explanation.en: Organic farming restores the ecological balance with locally made inputs; it costs less in inputs and gives healthier food, though yields may be lower at first.

body.en: Benefits: organic farming replaces costly agro-inputs with cheaper locally produced organic inputs; it earns income from exports, as demand for organic food is growing; its food is healthier and free of chemical residues; and it is labour intensive, so it creates rural employment. Limitations: yields are often lower in the early years; it needs awareness and support for farmers; small and marginal farmers find it hard to switch; organic produce may have a shorter shelf life and less choice in the off-season. Sikkim became India's first fully organic state in 2016.
body.kn: ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿ ಅಗ್ಗದ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಪರಿಕರ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ, ರಫ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ತರುತ್ತದೆ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಆಹಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಆರಂಭದ ಇಳುವರಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದು ಕಷ್ಟ. 2016 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಂ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಾವಯವ ರಾಜ್ಯವಾಯಿತು.

points.en: Benefits: cheaper inputs, exports, health, employment
Limits: lower early yields, shelf life, adoption by small farmers

narration.en: Organic farming uses cheap local inputs, earns export income, gives healthier food and creates jobs. But early yields are lower, small farmers find it hard to switch, and the produce spoils faster. Sikkim became fully organic in 2016.
